findings.title: Plugin request completion logs drop traceID
findings.body: "Plugin Request Completed" (eventName grafana-data-egress) used to include traceID from tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false) whenever it was non-empty. That parameter was removed and not replaced: ContextualLoggerMiddleware only stores endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, and uname via log.WithContextualAttributes, and plugins/log.FromContext does not add a trace id before Info. Info itself is not context-aware, so this call site no longer records the trace. Egress logs can no longer be correlated with the request trace (including unsampled traces, which the old false argument included). Put traceID back on the log params, or add the same TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false) value to the contextual attributes.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards subsequent log records
findings.body: FromContext ignores the receiver and returns NewTestLogger(), a new zero TestLogger. LoggerMiddleware now emits the completion log only through m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info, so every Debug/Info/Warn/Error call is recorded on that discarded instance and never increments the injected fake's InfoLogs/ErrorLogs (Calls, Message, or Ctx). Tests that inject TestLogger will not observe plugin request logs and can miss regressions, or fail if they assert on the original logger. FromContext should return the same TestLogger so records stay observable.

findings.title: No test checks that request identity fields still reach the completion log
findings.body: Identity fields were moved off LoggerMiddleware's explicit parameters into instrumentContext, and traceID was dropped, but nothing asserts the resulting "Plugin Request Completed" record. metrics_middleware_test.go only checks Prometheus counters and constructs MetricsMiddleware directly, so it never runs NewContextualLoggerMiddleware ahead of LoggerMiddleware. FromContext only sees endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, and uname if that middleware runs first and enriches the same context; a reorder or a missed attribute would not fail CI. Add a test that composes both middlewares and asserts those fields, plus traceID, on the completion log for the instrumented endpoints.
